Virat Kohli.pace: Exploit his vulnerability to balls angling away outside off stump. Bowl a 4th-stump channel with late away movement.
Virat Kohli.spin: Use left-arm orthodox sliding across him. Deny him the flick through mid-wicket to build dot-ball pressure.
Virat Kohli.tape: Classical anchor. Squeeze his scoring zones on the off-side and force him to take aerial risks against spin.

Rohit Sharma.pace: Attack the front pad immediately. Highly vulnerable to sharp inswinging deliveries in the first 2 overs.
Rohit Sharma.spin: Deploy leg-spin turning away from the bat. Limit his ability to sweep or slog over mid-wicket.
Rohit Sharma.tape: Lethal puller of the ball. Do NOT bowl short unless it is directed sharply at the armpit.

MS Dhoni.pace: Cannot quickly pivot to play the short ball anymore. Bowl extreme pace directed precisely at his ribcage.
MS Dhoni.spin: Bowl wide, flat darts outside off stump. Do not bowl into his pads.
MS Dhoni.tape: Legendary finisher. Deny him the helicopter shot by attacking the body with raw pace.

Suryakumar Yadav.pace: Pack the off-side field and execute wide yorkers consistently. Deny him the ability to shuffle inside the line.
Suryakumar Yadav.spin: Bowl flat, quick deliveries wide of off-stump. Do not offer flight.
Suryakumar Yadav.tape: 360-degree threat. Force him to hit through the off-side by strictly adhering to the wide tramline.

Jasprit Bumrah.pace: Target the stumps with raw pace if he bats.
Jasprit Bumrah.bat_against: Play him out securely. Do not take risks against his unique release point. Target the other bowlers in the attack.
Jasprit Bumrah.tape: The most lethal bowler in the world. Respect his 4 overs and attack the weak links.

Travis Head.pace: Highly susceptible to express pace swinging back into the pads. Target the base of middle and leg stump.
Travis Head.spin: Bowl pace-off cutters and slow left-arm orthodox to force him to generate his own power.
Travis Head.bat_against: Respect the pitch if it's turning, otherwise attack his part-time off-spin.
Travis Head.tape: Devastating in the powerplay. Don't give him width outside off. Attack the stumps with swing.

Heinrich Klaasen.pace: Bogged down by extremely wide, slow off-cutters and wide bouncers well outside his arc.
Heinrich Klaasen.spin: Do NOT bowl spin to him between overs 12-16. He will destroy it.
Heinrich Klaasen.tape: The best spin-hitter in the world. Rely entirely on pace-off variations outside the off-stump.

Andre Russell.pace: Commit fully to the extreme wide yorker or target the badge of the helmet. No half-measures.
Andre Russell.spin: Bowl leg-spin or mystery spin turning away from his hitting arc.
Andre Russell.bat_against: Slashes hard at wide balls. Wait for the pace-off cutter dug into the pitch.
Andre Russell.tape: Clears his front leg. Pack the off-side boundary and force him to reach for wide deliveries.

Rishabh Pant.pace: Loses balance when reaching for extreme wide deliveries from over the wicket.
Rishabh Pant.spin: Struggles to generate power against mystery spin turning away on slow pitches.
Rishabh Pant.tape: Highly unorthodox. Pack the off-side and strictly target the wide guideline.

Sanju Samson.pace: Bowl test-match lengths in the channel outside off. He often induces his own false shot due to high intent.
Sanju Samson.spin: Toss the ball up wide outside off-stump to invite the risky lofted drive.
Sanju Samson.tape: Incredibly gifted but impatient. Build dot-ball pressure early to force a mistake.

Hardik Pandya.pace: Struggles with back-of-length deliveries cramping his room. Bowl into the pitch at his lower chest.
Hardik Pandya.spin: Impatient against high-quality wrist spin tossed up wide.
Hardik Pandya.bat_against: Exploit his lack of raw pace. Look for the straight drive or slog sweep.
Hardik Pandya.tape: Pivotal all-rounder. Tie him down with hard lengths to force a frustrated slog.

Shubman Gill.pace: Lured into false drives by late outswing. Bowl full on the 4th stump line.
Shubman Gill.spin: Bowl tight, flat lines on the stumps. He takes time to accelerate against spin.
Shubman Gill.tape: Elegant timer. Squeeze his scoring zones on the off-side and force him to muscle the ball.

KL Rahul.pace: Over-cautious against extreme pace bouncers directed at the badge in the powerplay.
KL Rahul.spin: Gets bogged down by wrist spin in the middle overs. Bowl googlies outside off.
KL Rahul.tape: Exceptional anchor but can be tied down. Use aggressive pace early to stifle his strike rate.

Sunil Narine.pace: Cannot handle express pace directed straight at the armpit or throat.
Sunil Narine.spin: Do not bowl spin to him in the powerplay.
Sunil Narine.bat_against: Struggles to turn the ball on flat decks. Play the ball late and look for singles.
Sunil Narine.tape: Pinch-hitter and mystery spinner. Bounce him out with the bat, play him cautiously with the ball.

Rashid Khan.pace: Slashes wildly at wide pace-off deliveries.
Rashid Khan.spin: Can be beaten by flighted deliveries if forced to step out.
Rashid Khan.bat_against: Watch his wrist closely. Do not pre-meditate the sweep; play him off the pitch.
Rashid Khan.tape: Elite T20 spinner. Treat him as a 4-over survival test and attack the other bowlers.

Ruturaj Gaikwad.pace: Tentative against sharp inswing in the first two overs. Target the front pad.
Ruturaj Gaikwad.spin: Gets tucked up by left-arm orthodox sliding into him.
Ruturaj Gaikwad.tape: Classical timer. Deny him width and attack his body with high pace.

Yashasvi Jaiswal.pace: Tends to fetch wide deliveries, leading to sliced catches. Bowl wide of off-stump.
Yashasvi Jaiswal.spin: Bowl off-spin dragging him wide outside off stump.
Yashasvi Jaiswal.tape: Explosive opener. Feed him wide deliveries and pack the point and cover boundaries.

Rinku Singh.pace: Incredible at the death, but can be starved of strike by firing wide yorkers past the tramline.
Rinku Singh.spin: Keep the ball turning away from his hitting arc.
Rinku Singh.tape: Elite finisher. Commit fully to the wide yorker. Do not miss on the pads under any circumstances.

Nicholas Pooran.pace: Struggles to generate power on short, slow bouncers angled across his body.
Nicholas Pooran.spin: Vulnerable to mystery spin turning away from the bat.
Nicholas Pooran.tape: Destructive hitter. Force him to hit square of the wicket using pace-off variations.

Mitchell Starc.pace: Target the stumps with full, fast deliveries if he bats.
Mitchell Starc.bat_against: Beware of the lethal inswinging yorker. See off his first spell without taking risks.
Mitchell Starc.tape: Premium strike bowler. Play out his early swing and capitalize in his later spells if he loses rhythm.

Trent Boult.pace: Bowl short and at the body.
Trent Boult.spin: Keep it simple and at the stumps.
Trent Boult.bat_against: Watch out for the trademark first-over inswinger to the right-hander. Play with a straight bat.
Trent Boult.tape: Powerplay specialist. Do not chase wide deliveries early; protect your wickets in the first 6 overs.

Matheesha Pathirana.bat_against: Pick his release point late. Sit deep in the crease and wait for the missed yorker at the death.
Matheesha Pathirana.tape: Sling-action death specialist. Focus entirely on surviving his toe-crushing yorkers.

Shivam Dube.pace: Completely freezes against sharp, fast bouncers directed at his helmet. Attack the body.
Shivam Dube.spin: Do NOT bowl spin to him in the middle overs.
Shivam Dube.bat_against: Medium pacer. Exploit his lack of raw pace by stepping out of the crease.
Shivam Dube.tape: Spin-destroyer. Bring your fastest bowler back into the attack immediately when he walks out.

Sam Curran.pace: Struggles to get underneath low, dipping full tosses and yorkers at the death.
Sam Curran.spin: Bowl off-spin turning away from the left-hander.
Sam Curran.bat_against: Exploit his lack of extreme pace. Look to hit his back-of-length slower balls down the ground.
Sam Curran.tape: Smart all-rounder. Respect his cutters but attack his standard length deliveries.

Sachin Tendulkar.pace: Vulnerable to sharp inswing in his early innings. Pitch it up and look for LBW.
Sachin Tendulkar.spin: Playful against left-arm spin, can be drawn out of his crease with flight.
Sachin Tendulkar.tape: The Master. Avoid giving him width outside off. Build dot ball pressure to force a rare mistake.

AB de Villiers.pace: Loses balance reaching for extreme wide yorkers outside off-stump at the death.
AB de Villiers.spin: Can be tucked up by left-arm orthodox sliding into his pads early on.
AB de Villiers.tape: Mr. 360. Do not bowl length anywhere near the stumps. Commit fully to the wide tramline.

Chris Gayle.pace: Struggles with express pace short balls aimed directly at his ribcage. He cannot pivot quickly.
Chris Gayle.spin: Bowl off-spin darting into his pads or wide of off-stump to restrict his swing arc.
Chris Gayle.bat_against: Part-time off-spinner. Attack him straight down the ground.
Chris Gayle.tape: The Universe Boss. Do not pitch the ball up in his hitting arc. Cramp him with extreme pace at the body.

Adam Gilchrist.pace: Vulnerable to around-the-wicket seamers angling the ball into his pads.
Adam Gilchrist.spin: Attack his stumps with off-spin from round the wicket.
Adam Gilchrist.tape: Explosive opener. Deny him width to cut and slash. Keep the field up on the leg side.

Virender Sehwag.pace: Lacks footwork early. Bowl fast, full outswingers to induce the outside edge.
Virender Sehwag.spin: Bowl flat and wide of off-stump to force him to reach.
Virender Sehwag.bat_against: Part-time off-spinner. Exploit his lack of variations.
Virender Sehwag.tape: Hand-eye coordination genius. Pitch it up with swing early; do not bowl short as he cuts fiercely.

Gautam Gambhir.pace: Tends to poke at deliveries angling across him outside off-stump.
Gautam Gambhir.spin: Use off-spin turning into him to cramp his inside-out shots.
Gautam Gambhir.tape: Anchoring lefty. Keep the ball outside his off-stump on a good length and invite the false drive.

Suresh Raina.pace: Notorious weakness against aggressive short-pitch bowling aimed at the throat.
Suresh Raina.spin: Excellent against spin. Bowl flat darts to restrict boundaries.
Suresh Raina.bat_against: Part-time off-spinner. Look to rotate strike.
Suresh Raina.tape: Mr. IPL. Bring on your fastest bowler immediately and enforce a heavy short-ball barrage.

Lasith Malinga.pace: Target the stumps with full, fast deliveries if he bats.
Lasith Malinga.bat_against: Watch for the slinging, dipping yorker. Play him off the pitch and respect his death overs.
Lasith Malinga.tape: The greatest death bowler. Do not take unnecessary risks against his yorkers; attack the other bowlers.

Shane Watson.pace: Highly vulnerable to sharp inswing targeting the front pad. Prime LBW candidate.
Shane Watson.spin: Can be beaten in flight by high-quality wrist spin.
Shane Watson.bat_against: Struggles to generate express pace. Look to attack his slower cutters.
Shane Watson.tape: Powerful all-rounder. Attack his pads early with the new ball before he settles.

Kieron Pollard.pace: Struggles to get underneath extreme wide yorkers. Slashes hard and misses.
Kieron Pollard.spin: Vulnerable to sharp googlies turning back into his body.
Kieron Pollard.bat_against: Relies on dipping off-cutters. Wait on the back foot to punch him down the ground.
Kieron Pollard.tape: Brute force finisher. Do not bowl at the stumps at the death. Commit entirely to the wide line.

Rahul Tewatia.pace: Struggles against extreme pace targeted at the badge of the helmet.
Rahul Tewatia.spin: He heavily pre-meditates the sweep shot. Bowl fast and flat directly on the stumps.
Rahul Tewatia.bat_against: Play his leg-spin late. Look for gaps rather than aerial shots.
Rahul Tewatia.tape: Clutch finisher. Do not give the ball air when he bats. Fire darts into his pads.

Jake Fraser-McGurk.pace: Hits blindly through the line of the ball. Highly vulnerable to dipping off-cutters and pace-off variations.
Jake Fraser-McGurk.spin: Toss the ball up extremely wide to force him to lose his shape.
Jake Fraser-McGurk.tape: Ultra-aggressive hitter. Take all the pace off the ball and let him swing himself out of form.

Mayank Yadav.pace: Target the stumps with raw pace if he bats.
Mayank Yadav.bat_against: Express pace (150km/h+). Use his pace to find boundaries behind square; do not try to over-hit him.
Mayank Yadav.tape: Pace sensation. Play him late and use his extreme velocity to your advantage.

Abhishek Sharma.pace: Tends to slash hard at deliveries angling across him. Bowl back of a length outside off.
Abhishek Sharma.spin: Vulnerable to high-quality off-spin dragging him out of his crease.
Abhishek Sharma.bat_against: Part-time spinner. Target him to break his rhythm.
Abhishek Sharma.tape: Aggressive opener. Angle the ball across him with high pace and pack the point boundary.

Sai Sudharsan.pace: Takes time to accelerate. Bowl tight lines to frustrate him.
Sai Sudharsan.spin: Can get bogged down by tight left-arm orthodox sliding across him.
Sai Sudharsan.tape: Classical anchor. Choke his strike rate early to force a panicked shot later in the innings.

Tilak Varma.pace: Can be tucked up by high-pace back-of-a-length deliveries aimed at the ribcage.
Tilak Varma.spin: Struggles slightly against mystery spin turning away from the left-hander.
Tilak Varma.bat_against: Part-time off-spin. Respect the pitch if it's turning.
Tilak Varma.tape: Solid middle-order bat. Cramp his room with hard lengths to prevent him from freeing his arms.

Ashutosh Sharma.pace: Exceptional at scooping and sweeping pace. You MUST bowl fast bouncers to push him deep into the crease.
Ashutosh Sharma.spin: Restrict his sweep shot with full, wide lines.
Ashutosh Sharma.tape: Unorthodox finisher. Do not bowl predictable yorkers. Hit the deck hard and aim for the helmet.

Shashank Singh.pace: Struggles to generate power on slow, wide off-cutters dug into the pitch.
Shashank Singh.spin: Vulnerable to leg-spin turning away from his hitting arc.
Shashank Singh.tape: Powerful striker. Keep the ball away from his body and utilize dipping slower balls.

Nitish Kumar Reddy.pace: Vulnerable to raw pace angling into his pads early in his innings.
Nitish Kumar Reddy.spin: Can be beaten in flight by high-quality wrist spin.
Nitish Kumar Reddy.bat_against: Medium pacer. Exploit his lack of raw pace with aggressive intent.
Nitish Kumar Reddy.tape: Promising all-rounder. Test his technique with sharp incoming deliveries before he gets set.
